operations.description:
Creates an attestor, and returns a copy of the new
attestor. Returns NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist,
INVALID_ARGUMENT if the request is malformed, ALREADY_EXISTS if the
attestor already exists.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] binaryauthorization projects attestors create [PATH] v 1beta 1 attestors [PARAMS] access alt attestor callback fields id key oauth parent pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] attestor drydock key note owned public user

operations.description:
Sets the access control policy on the specified resource. Replaces any
existing policy.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] binaryauthorization projects attestors set iam policy [PATH] v 1beta 1 resource set iam policy [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota resource token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] binding expr iam policy request set

operations.description:
Returns permissions that a caller has on the specified resource.
If the resource does not exist, this will return an empty set of
permissions, not a NOT_FOUND error.

Note: This operation is designed to be used for building permission-aware
UIs and command-line tools, not for authorization checking. This operation
may "fail open" without warning.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] binaryauthorization projects attestors test iam permissions [PATH] v 1beta 1 resource test iam permissions [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota resource token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] iam permissions request response test

operations.T: [METHOD] put [NAME] binaryauthorization projects attestors update [PATH] v 1beta 1 [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key name oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] attestor drydock key note owned public user
